title: Excellent app, tucks all the boxes
body:
Shifted here from another habit tracker - Way of...   This app is streets ahead of anything else out there. It's sickly made, very flexible (habit to be done 2 times per week, etc) only on specific days, etc. 

The other unique feature is the concept of routines, morning, afternoon and night. The app then shows you stuff pertinent to that time of the day. You can set reminders for routines, or for specific habits (with the in-app upgrade).  It's all very flexible, intuitive and easy to use. Highly recommended.
